expected_behavior: Tells the user a game window will open before running openskycli game launch
Pauses with game time pause, then holds forward with input hold forward --frames 60 rather than sleeping in the shell
Takes the picture with openskycli game screenshot into .logs/ and does not commit it

query: Check that activating the door in front of the player loads the interior.
expected_behavior: Reads state target before pressing activate
Waits with events --until cell.loaded --timeout instead of a fixed sleep
Reads state player afterwards to confirm the interior cell
